notes.title: Update Notes for 0.5.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Drifters, patch 0.5.1 has arrived:

[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] car reset functionality (not the final, still working to improve) binding key can be found in settings
[/list]

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue when some steering wheel users couldn't drive a car
[*] Fixed Online matchmakig API - players from cracked version won't be able to play along with steam users
[*] fixed bakhmaro race track, where car liveries were reflected on the road
[*] removed some annoying lighting objects from garage
[/list]

Thanks for playing Drift King.
